QuestInfo.name: The Broken Seal
QuestInfo.1: The Master Omen is overwhelming you with its dark aura. It's an ominous power just like that time centuries ago. Defeat it and go see the Seal Stone of Time.
QuestInfo.2: The Seal Stone of Time that bound the Black Mage centuries ago was shattered. You knew it would not last forever, but your sacrifice still feels futile. You don't want to regret your decisions, but seeing it all now...

0.msg: It's completely shattered. I knew it was going to be... I guess I should be happy that my sacrifice kept Maple World safe for hundreds of years. But that's such a small comfort after everything I've been through.

1.msg: I don't regret my choice. It was the only way to save Maple World. But... knowing what I know now...
